title: braya humilis var. leiocarpa
intro: Braya humilis var. leiocarpa, commonly known as alpine rockcress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Braya humilis var. leiocarpa include its ability to reduce inflammation and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a promising candidate for further research in the development of new treatments. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
